name: OS Window Choreography
summary: Windows are the cast: dashboards pile up, spread Exposé-style and genie away while Pulse stays on top as a small utility window.
look: A teal gradient desktop with branded window chrome, a translucent dock and soft deep shadows. The agent is a teal-rimmed always-on-top utility window; a coral thread links evidence across windows.

motion.name: Exposé spread
motion.how: FLIP stack to grid, 0.6 s expo.out, 0.04 s stagger, lands on the drop

motion.name: Auto-zoom follow
motion.how: camera 1.8x on each click, 0.7 s power2.inOut, clicks on beats

motion.name: Genie
motion.how: 12 strips scaleX/skew toward the dock with a delay gradient, one window per beat

story: Hook: dashboard windows cascade in one per beat until a note window asks how many dashboards you checked today. Reveal: the pile spreads into an Exposé grid and the teal-rimmed Acme Pulse utility window drops into the centre. Proof: the deploy log highlights #2231, a coral thread links it to the checkout conversion drop, and the Pulse window shows −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231; the pointer clicks Roll back. CTA: the windows genie into the dock, leaving one window with the lockup, 'You ship. Pulse watches.' and Start free.
adapt: The windows become the tools your customers juggle today; your product is the utility window that stays on top and the only dock icon left running.

fit.risk: a too-literal OS look feels generic; brand the chrome and wallpaper
